title: Cosmic Smiling Orb
description: A vibrant green orb with a smiling face floats above a lush, flower-filled meadow path. A giant human hand reaches down from the swirling purple and gold cosmic sky toward the glowing orb, which is surrounded by colorful orbs and foliage.
prompt: A giant dark human hand reaches down from a swirling purple and gold cosmic vortex sky toward a glowing green orb with a happy smiling face. The orb floats above a winding golden path through a lush meadow filled with blue and white daisies and colorful flowers. Surrounded by floating colorful orbs and vibrant foliage, in a dreamy whimsical fantasy style.
